# Goal 1: Merge Access

## Row

```{python}
import htmltools
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.dates as mdates
import seaborn as sns
import sys
import os
import datetime

project_root = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), '..'))

if project_root not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, project_root)

from src.database import DatabaseManager
from src.evaluation import goal_series, current_vs_previous, GOAL_STATEMENTS, GOAL_HEADLINE_COLUMN, DEFINITIONS

db = DatabaseManager("../data/analytics.db")

# A single call computes every goal's rolling 6-month-window series (stepped
# quarterly) in one pass; this can take up to ~a minute at render time since it
# instantiates many MetricsCalculators under the hood.
series = goal_series(db_path="../data/analytics.db")

g1 = series['goal1_core_team_size']
g2 = series['goal2_community_merge_time']
g3 = series['goal3_support_response']
g4 = series['goal4_community_contributions']
g5 = series['goal5_new_contributors']

cvp1 = current_vs_previous(g1, GOAL_HEADLINE_COLUMN['goal1_core_team_size'])
cvp2 = current_vs_previous(g2, GOAL_HEADLINE_COLUMN['goal2_community_merge_time'])
cvp3 = current_vs_previous(g3, GOAL_HEADLINE_COLUMN['goal3_support_response'])
cvp4 = current_vs_previous(g4, GOAL_HEADLINE_COLUMN['goal4_community_contributions'])
cvp5 = current_vs_previous(g5, GOAL_HEADLINE_COLUMN['goal5_new_contributors'])
cvp5_commit = current_vs_previous(g5, 'new_commit_contributors')

last_sync = "Last Sync Time: N/A"
_ts = db.get_last_sync_time()
if _ts:
    last_sync = (
        "Last Sync Time: "
        + datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(_ts.replace('Z', '+00:00')).strftime('%b %d, %Y %I:%M %p')
        + " UTC"
    )


def fmt_metric(value, kind: str) -> str:
    """Format a headline metric value, showing '–' for missing/NaN data.

    The local jsPsych PR sync currently lags (REST data ends 2025-09), so the
    most recent one-to-three rolling windows for goals 2 and 5 can be NaN/0
    until the next sync fills them in.
    """
    if value is None or (isinstance(value, float) and pd.isna(value)):
        return "–"
    if kind == 'days':
        return f"{value:.2f}"
    return f"{int(round(value))}"


def fmt_change(change_pct) -> str:
    """Format a current-vs-previous percent change, or '–' if undefined."""
    if change_pct is None or (isinstance(change_pct, float) and pd.isna(change_pct)):
        return "–"
    sign = "+" if change_pct >= 0 else ""
    return f"{sign}{change_pct:.1f}%"


def plot_goal_series(df: pd.DataFrame, y_specs, ylabel: str, title: str) -> None:
    """Plot one or more columns of a goal series over window_end.

    y_specs is a list of (column, label) tuples. NaN values (from stale
    trailing windows) simply produce a gap in the line rather than an error or
    a dropped point -- matplotlib handles NaN gaps natively.
    """
    sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="Set2")
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6))
    if df.empty:
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No data available for this period',
                horizontalalignment='center', verticalalignment='center',
                transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=12, color='red')
        ax.set_title(title)
        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()
        return

    df = df.copy()
    df['window_end'] = pd.to_datetime(df['window_end'])
    palette = sns.color_palette('Set2')
    for i, (col, label) in enumerate(y_specs):
        ax.plot(df['window_end'], df[col], marker='o', markersize=4,
                linewidth=2, label=label, color=palette[i % len(palette)])

    ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.YearLocator())
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%Y'))
    ax.set_xlabel('Year')
    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel)
    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.legend()
    ax.grid(True, which='both', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

*Each point is a trailing 6-month window, stepped quarterly.*
